```{r}
#| label: load
library(jsonlite)
pubs_data <- fromJSON(here::here("_data", "publications.json"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
pubs <- pubs_data$publications
total_cites <- sum(vapply(pubs, \(p) if (is.null(p$cited_by)) 0 else p$cited_by, numeric(1)))

# Each group of cards sits in a collapsible <details> block, closed by default,
# with a one-line summary. The markdown cards inside still render, because the
# HTML tags are on their own lines with blank lines around them.
group_open  <- function(summary) cat(sprintf('\n<details class="pub-group">\n<summary>%s</summary>\n\n', summary))
group_close <- function() cat("\n</details>\n\n")

# Series names, matching the SERIES table in assets/lua/series.lua
series_names <- c("command-line" = "Bioinformatics on the command line")
```

## Peer-reviewed papers

::: {.pub-intro}
My work at Stellenbosch University's Division of Molecular Biology and Human Genetics has contributed to `r length(pubs)` peer-reviewed papers, cited `r total_cites` times according to Crossref.

[ORCID: `r pubs_data$orcid`](https://orcid.org/`r pubs_data$orcid`){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary}
:::

```{r}
#| label: list
#| output: asis
# Match on surname: papers list me as "Allies D" or "Allies DL".
my_position <- function(authors) which(startsWith(unlist(authors), "Allies "))[1]

format_authors <- function(authors) {
  authors <- unlist(authors)
  n <- length(authors)
  pos <- my_position(authors)
  shown <- head(authors, 3)
  if (!is.na(pos) && pos <= 3) shown[pos] <- paste0("**", shown[pos], "**")
  out <- paste(shown, collapse = ", ")
  if (!is.na(pos) && pos > 3) out <- paste0(out, ", … **", authors[pos], "**")
  if (n > max(3, if (is.na(pos)) 0 else pos)) out <- paste0(out, ", et al.")
  out
}

group_open(sprintf("Latest: %s", pubs[[1]]$title))
for (p in pubs) {
  ref <- paste0("*", p$journal, "*. ", p$year)
  if (!is.null(p$volume)) ref <- paste0(ref, ";", p$volume)
  if (!is.null(p$issue))  ref <- paste0(ref, "(", p$issue, ")")
  if (!is.null(p$pages))  ref <- paste0(ref, ":", p$pages)

  links <- c(
    if (!is.null(p$doi))   sprintf("[DOI](https://doi.org/%s){.btn .btn-sm .btn-primary}", p$doi),
    if (!is.null(p$pmid))  sprintf("[PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/%s/){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary}", p$pmid),
    if (!is.null(p$pmcid)) sprintf("[Free full text](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/%s/){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary}", p$pmcid)
  )

  pos <- my_position(p$authors)
  role <- if (is.na(pos)) "" else sprintf("Author %d of %d · ", pos, length(p$authors))
  cites <- if (is.null(p$cited_by)) "" else sprintf("Cited %d times", p$cited_by)

  cat(
    "::: {.pub-card}\n",
    sprintf("[%s]{.pub-year}\n\n", p$year),
    sprintf("[%s]{.pub-title}\n\n", p$title),
    sprintf("[%s]{.pub-authors}\n\n", format_authors(p$authors)),
    sprintf("%s\n\n", ref),
    sprintf("[%s%s]{.pub-meta}\n\n", role, cites),
    paste(links, collapse = "\n"), "\n",
    ":::\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}
group_close()
```

## On this site

::: {.pub-intro}
Longer articles published here, with the data and code to follow along.
:::

```{r}
#| label: site-articles
#| output: asis
# Every article in writing/<name>/index.qmd, from its own front matter, grouped
# by series (in part order), then standalone articles (newest first)
site_articles <- list.files(here::here("writing"), pattern = "^index\\.qmd$",
                            recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
site_articles <- lapply(site_articles, \(f) {
  meta <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(f)
  meta$href <- paste0("writing/", basename(dirname(f)), "/index.qmd")
  meta
})
# Articles dated in the future are drafts: leave them out until their date
site_articles <- Filter(\(m) as.Date(m$date) <= Sys.Date(), site_articles)

article_card <- function(a, label) {
  tags <- paste(sprintf("[%s]{.article-tag}", unlist(a$categories)), collapse = " ")
  cat(
    "::: {.pub-card .article-card}\n",
    sprintf("[%s]{.pub-year}\n\n", label),
    sprintf("[%s]{.pub-title}\n\n", a$title),
    sprintf("%s\n\n", a$subtitle),
    sprintf("%s\n\n", tags),
    sprintf("[Read the article](%s){.btn .btn-sm .btn-primary}\n", a$href),
    ":::\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}
fmt_date <- function(d) format(as.Date(d), "%d %B %Y")

# One group per series
in_series <- Filter(\(a) !is.null(a$series), site_articles)
for (key in unique(vapply(in_series, \(a) a$series, ""))) {
  parts <- Filter(\(a) a$series == key, in_series)
  parts <- parts[order(vapply(parts, \(a) as.numeric(a[["series-part"]]), numeric(1)))]
  name <- if (key %in% names(series_names)) series_names[[key]] else key
  cat(sprintf("\n### %s {.pub-group-heading}\n\n", name))
  group_open(sprintf("Latest: %s", parts[[length(parts)]]$title))
  for (a in parts) article_card(a, sprintf("Part %s · %s", a[["series-part"]], fmt_date(a$date)))
  group_close()
}

# Standalone articles, newest first
standalone <- Filter(\(a) is.null(a$series), site_articles)
standalone <- standalone[order(vapply(standalone, \(a) as.character(a$date), ""), decreasing = TRUE)]
if (length(standalone) > 0) {
  cat("\n### Standalone articles {.pub-group-heading}\n\n")
  group_open(sprintf("Latest: %s", standalone[[1]]$title))
  for (a in standalone) article_card(a, fmt_date(a$date))
  group_close()
}
```

## On Medium

::: {.pub-intro}
Plain-language writing on Medium about reproducible research, scientific writing with Quarto, and what sim racing and flight simulators taught me about checklists.

[All articles on Medium](https://medium.com/@alliesdl){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary}
:::

```{r}
#| label: articles
#| output: asis
group_open(sprintf("Latest: %s", pubs_data$articles[[1]]$title))
for (a in pubs_data$articles) {
  date_label <- format(as.Date(a$date), "%d %B %Y")
  tags <- paste(sprintf("[%s]{.article-tag}", unlist(a$tags)), collapse = " ")
  cat(
    "::: {.pub-card .article-card}\n",
    sprintf("[%s · %d min read]{.pub-year}\n\n", date_label, a$minutes),
    sprintf("[%s]{.pub-title}\n\n", a$title),
    sprintf("%s\n\n", a$excerpt),
    sprintf("%s\n\n", tags),
    sprintf("[Read on Medium](%s){.btn .btn-sm .btn-primary}\n", a$url),
    ":::\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}
group_close()
```

```{=html}
<script>
// Open a group when "On this page" (or a link with #section) points into it
function openGroupFor(hash) {
  if (!hash) return;
  const target = document.getElementById(decodeURIComponent(hash.slice(1)));
  if (!target) return;
  const section = target.closest("section") || target;
  section.querySelectorAll(":scope > details.pub-group, :scope > div > details.pub-group").forEach(d => d.open = true);
}
window.addEventListener("hashchange", () => openGroupFor(location.hash));
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  openGroupFor(location.hash);
  document.querySelectorAll("#TOC a[href^='#']").forEach(a =>
    a.addEventListener("click", () => openGroupFor(a.getAttribute("href"))));
});
</script>
```
